# AI Coding Agent Instructions for El Rey Jesús PF WordPress Theme

## Project Overview
This is a WordPress theme built on the [Sage](https://roots.io/sage/) framework, integrating Laravel components via [Acorn](https://github.com/roots/acorn). It uses modern frontend tooling with [Bud](https://bud.js.org/) for asset compilation and [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/) for styling.

## Architecture & Key Components

### Core Structure
- **`app/`**: PHP application logic with Laravel-style organization
  - `setup.php`: Theme initialization, asset enqueuing, menu registration
  - `ajax.php`: AJAX endpoint handlers for dynamic content loading
  - `filters.php`: WordPress filter hooks
  - `cpt/`: Custom post type definitions (events, multimedia, fap)
  - `enqueue/`: Asset enqueuing logic with `wp_localize_script` for JS data passing
  - `form/`: Custom form handlers with database table creation
  - `Providers/`: Service providers extending SageServiceProvider
  - `View/Composers/`: Laravel Blade view composers for data injection
  - `Walkers/`: Custom menu walkers

- **`resources/`**: Source assets and templates
  - `views/`: Laravel Blade templates with `@yield('content')` pattern
  - `scripts/`: JavaScript files (Alpine.js for interactions)
  - `styles/`: CSS/SCSS with Tailwind classes
  - `images/` & `fonts/`: Static assets

- **`public/`**: Compiled assets with hashed filenames (generated by Bud)

### Key Patterns & Conventions

#### Custom Post Types
Register CPTs in `app/cpt/` files with `register_post_type()` and associated taxonomies. Always include `'show_in_rest' => true` for block editor compatibility.

#### AJAX Implementation
- Enqueue scripts in `app/enqueue/` using `wp_enqueue_script()` and `wp_localize_script()`
- Pass `admin_url('admin-ajax.php')` as `ajax_url` to JavaScript
- Handle requests in `app/ajax.php` with `wp_ajax_` and `wp_ajax_nopriv_` hooks
- Use nonces for security: `wp_create_nonce()` and `wp_verify_nonce()`

#### Forms & Database
- Custom forms create tables using `dbDelta()` in activation functions
- Process submissions via `admin_post_` hooks in `app/form/`
- Sanitize with `sanitize_text_field()`, `sanitize_email()`, `sanitize_textarea_field()`
- Store in custom tables with `$wpdb->insert()`

#### View Composers
- Extend `Roots\Acorn\View\Composer` in `app/View/Composers/`
- Define `$views` array for applicable templates
- Return data array from `with()` method
- Available in Blade templates as variables

#### Asset Management
- Use Bud's `@scripts/` and `@styles/` aliases in entry files
- Compile with `npm run build` or `npm run dev` (watch mode)
- Enqueue bundles with `bundle('app')->enqueue()` in `app/setup.php`

#### Templates
- Main layout in `resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php`
- Include sections: `@include('sections.header')`, `@include('sections.footer')`
- Use `@yield('content')` for page content
- Alpine.js loaded via CDN in layout head

## Development Workflow

### Setup
```bash
composer install  # Install PHP dependencies
npm install       # Install Node dependencies
npm run dev       # Start development server with file watching
```

### Build Commands
```bash
npm run build     # Production build
npm run dev       # Development build with watching
```

### Translation
```bash
npm run translate:pot     # Generate POT file
npm run translate:update  # Update existing PO files
npm run translate:compile # Compile MO files
```

### Key Files to Reference
- `bud.config.js`: Build configuration and entry points
- `tailwind.config.js`: Tailwind customization
- `composer.json`: PHP dependencies
- `package.json`: Node scripts and dependencies
- `theme.json`: Block editor configuration (auto-generated)

## Common Patterns

### Enqueuing Scripts with Data
```php
wp_enqueue_script('my-script', get_template_directory_uri() . '/path/to/script.js', [], '1.0', true);
wp_localize_script('my-script', 'my_ajax_object', [
    'ajax_url' => admin_url('admin-ajax.php'),
    'nonce' => wp_create_nonce('my_nonce')
]);
```

### AJAX Handler
```php
add_action('wp_ajax_my_action', function() {
    check_ajax_referer('my_nonce', 'nonce');
    // Process request
    wp_send_json(['success' => true]);
});
```

### Custom Database Table
```php
global $wpdb;
$table = $wpdb->prefix . 'my_table';
$sql = "CREATE TABLE $table (
    id mediumint(9) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    data text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
) {$wpdb->get_charset_collate()};";
require_once(ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/upgrade.php');
dbDelta($sql);
```

### View Composer
```php
class MyComposer extends Composer {
    protected static $views = ['template-name'];
    public function with() {
        return ['variable' => 'value'];
    }
}
```

Focus on maintaining the Sage/Acorn architecture patterns, proper WordPress hooks usage, and secure data handling practices established in this codebase.</content>
